title: Mars Climate Orbiter: own the meaning of an interface
focus: An interface contract includes semantic meaning, producers, consumers, checks, and operational handover.

sources.title: Mars Climate Orbiter Mishap Investigation Board Phase I Report
sources.limitations: Relevant sections inspected; this is not a reconstruction of every event or finding.

facts.statement: The board identified English-unit impulse data in a ground-software output where the interface specified metric units; navigation processing assumed the specified units.
Its contributing causes also included transition to operations, communication, staffing, training, and ground-software verification weaknesses.

retrospective.boundary: Spacecraft events, ground data generation, navigation ingestion, trajectory review, and development-to-operations handover belong to one mission information flow.
interfaces: Producer → consumer: numerical values require units, reference frame, sign convention, timing, and version.
Predicted trajectory → operations team: persistent residuals need owned investigation and escalation.

decision.question: What closes an interface verification claim?
options: Each team reports its own software test success.
Both teams demonstrate shared semantics with an independently checked end-to-end sample.
decision.recommendation: Require a semantic contract and operational anomaly ownership together.
decision.uncertainty: A unit-tagged file alone does not verify the physical quantity, calibration, or trajectory model.

rows: Declare quantity, units, frame, sign, and event interval
Hand-checkable input/output sample agreed by both teams
Negative tests and observed error handling
Assign residual investigation and escalation owner
Recorded threshold rationale and disposition history

questions: Why is adding unit conversion code an incomplete corrective action?
Who owns acceptance when producer and consumer are different organizations?
State what a persistent unexplained residual means without declaring a cause prematurely.
answer_signals: Separates schema conformance from physical meaning.
Includes end-to-end evidence and handover responsibility.
Keeps investigation open until discrepancies are explained.
retrospective.transfer_exercise: Synthetic: a supplier delivers actuator impulse data to a fleet model. Draft a sample contract including one rejection case.
retrospective.limits: No reconstructed orbit or numerical failure simulation is provided. The original report describes multiple contributing conditions.
